====================
= How to add Lloyd =
====================
Through natural story progression Lloyd will be added to the party. 

If you have an existing playthrough make sure Lloyd Mod is enabled on your campaign and you have defeated Lloyd already. Once you have defeated Lloyd return to the Flanvel Tower and Lloyd will be added automatically.

=====================
= How to play Lloyd =
=====================
-----------
Normal Mode
-----------
Lloyd currently has two basic physical spell attacks in his Human form. All of Lloyd's attacks use MP. Lloyd is designed to have 7 dragoon levels.

Running Slash 
200% Damage
Restore 20 MP on hit and 30 * (Dragoon Level / 2) SP.

Spectral Slash (30 MP)
600% Damage
Restore 100 * (Dragoon Level / 2) SP at the cost of 30 MP.

Lloyd has a “Dragoon” form through the “Chaos Divine Dragoon Spirit” where he gains access to other both physical and magic spells. Each of Lloyd’s attacks in Dragoon form will heal 20 MP.

Sword Rush
200% Damage
Restore 20 MP on hit.

Aerial Crash (30 MP)
300% Damage
Restore 20 MP on hit.

Ball Barrage (50 MP) 
500% Magic Damage to the main target and 100% to every other target.
Restore 20 MP on hit.

Sigil of Explosion (70 MP)
400% Magic Damage to all targets.
Restore 20 MP on hit.

Draonic Impale (90 MP)
600% Damage.
Restore 20 MP on Hit.

-------------------------
Dragoon Modifier Version
------------------------
When playing with Dragoon Modifier or any other mod that requests the Dragoon Modifier Version of Lloyd his gameplay changes. Lloyd will always start the battle with 0 MP. The goal of this of Lloyd is to stay in Dragoon as long as possible. When his Dragoon Spells are used for the first time once per transformation they will regenerate large amount of SP. Lloyd can not restore more SP than the maximum amount available on the start of his turn.

Running Slash
100% Damage
Restore 10 MP on hit and 30 SP.

Spectral Sword (30 MP)
200% Damage
Restore 105 SP on hit.

Sword Rush
150% Damage
Restore 20 SP and 20 MP on hit.

Aerial Crash (30 MP)
200% Damage
When used for the first time restore 200 SP.
When Aerial Crash, Ball Barrage, Sigil of Explsion, and Draconic Impale have been used at least once, Aerial Crash will restore 25 SP and 40 MP.

Ball Barrage (50 MP)
300% Magic Damage to the main target and 100% to every other target.
When used for the first time restore 300 SP.

Sigil of Explosion (70 MP)
400% Magic Damage to all targets.
When used for the first time restore 400 SP.

Draonic Impale (90 MP)
500% Damage
When used for the first time restore 500 SP.

Dragoon Modifier version of Lloyd will also give Lloyd item magic spells while in Dragoon. When Lloyd uses one of these spells he will gain 80 SP.

Trans Light
Dancing Ray
Spinning Gale
Rave Twister
Fatal Blizzard

=============
= Hot Prize =
=============
Lloyd uses a series of button presses that pops up in the middle of the screen during his spells to deal the full damage of the attack.
Different spells will have a different amount of button presses and they are random each time you use the spell, however the amount of button presses will remain the same.
Each spell also has a different time window for the button presses you can do.
If you don't do any button presses you will deal 50% of the intended damage.
If you miss any hits the timer you can input the other buttons will decrease.
This can be toggled with Auto Additions options from Base Severed Chains or with Ultimate Wargod. 

==========================
= How to add Lloyd Early =
==========================
When creating a new campaign with Lloyd mod enabled when you first gain control of Dart click your equivalent of the “Square” button multiple times to add Lloyd early at level 1 to the party. If using Dragoon Modifier and you want to add other party members this should be done first before trying to add Lloyd.
